slot.brief: Ask which noble-gas fluoride does not exist / correct compositions of XeF2, XeF4, XeF6.

stem: Which sequence gives the formulas of the three commonly known xenon fluorides in increasing oxidation state of xenon?

verdicts.working: Fluorine is −1, so xenon is +2 in XeF₂, +4 in XeF₄, and +6 in XeF₆. The increasing order is XeF₂, XeF₄, XeF₆.

working:
$\text{XeF}_2$: Xe oxidation state $+2$; $\text{XeF}_4$: $+4$; $\text{XeF}_6$: $+6$. Thus, the sequence in increasing oxidation state is $\text{XeF}_2$, $\text{XeF}_4$, $\text{XeF}_6$.

Independent check: Fluorine is −1, so xenon is +2 in XeF₂, +4 in XeF₄, and +6 in XeF₆. The increasing order is XeF₂, XeF₄, XeF₆.
